runtime.discovery: utils.lut_manager.LUTManager scans lut-preset/ recursively at runtime
runtime.deployment_handling: The selected files are already tracked in the Lumina source tree; a source checkout or release package must retain lut-preset/. No separate copy step is needed when that directory is included.

luts.name: Bambu Lab PLA Basic RYBW
luts.source: Lumina lut-preset/bambulab/; Bambu Lab PLA Basic filename and bundled preset
luts.reason: Canonical four-channel RYBW preset for the selected Bambu PLA Basic palette; its 32×32×3 array matches Lumina's four-color LUT shape.

luts.name: Bambu Lab PLA Basic CMYW
luts.source: Lumina lut-preset/bambulab/; Bambu Lab PLA Basic filename and bundled preset
luts.reason: Canonical four-channel CMYW preset for the CMYW tray; it is the stable non-suffixed companion to the RYBW preset.

luts.name: Bambu Lab PLA Basic CMYW (new revision)
luts.source: Lumina lut-preset/bambulab/; bundled file with the _new suffix
luts.reason: Keep available for comparison or manual selection, but do not make two CMYW defaults compete in a fresh deployment until the revision's measurement provenance is confirmed.

luts.name: Custom Bambulab PLA RYBW
luts.source: Lumina lut-preset/Custom/; custom-named Bambulab PLA preset
luts.reason: Useful fallback, but Custom does not establish the same official baseline or measurement conditions as the canonical bambulab/ preset.

luts.name: Custom Bambulab PLA CMYW six-color
luts.source: Lumina lut-preset/Custom/; custom-named Bambulab PLA preset
luts.reason: This is a six-color CMYW-family LUT, while the selected tray is four-color CMYW; preinstalling it as a default would make channel count and slot mapping easy to confuse.

luts.name: Custom Bambulab PLA eight-color
luts.source: Lumina lut-preset/Custom/; custom-named Bambulab PLA preset
luts.reason: Eight-color mode uses Lumina's unified W/C/M/Y/K/R/B/G slots and requires a different tray; retain for deliberate eight-color workflows rather than the four-color seed.

luts.name: Custom Bambulab PLA BW
luts.source: Lumina lut-preset/Custom/; custom-named Bambulab PLA preset
luts.reason: A two-color fallback is useful for monochrome jobs but is outside the RYBW/CMYW tray scope.
